plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Motion Graphics, Graphic Arts and Media Technology, AA' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/graphic-arts-and-media-technology-motion-graphics-aa/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Graphic Arts and Media Technology Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The catalog defines footnote 5 on this page ('See general education requirements for AA/AS'); grid rows shown blank with units in semesters 3-4 do not name a specific course in the published schedule — modeled as choice slots; see advisor (catalog footnote 4: see Graphic Arts & Media Technology Faculty Adviser for sequencing of GAMT requirements). Designed to transfer to the BA in Visual Media at NSU (no foreign language requirement); UNR's BA has a 0-14 credit foreign language requirement. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid.
